args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the receiving supervisor at the Mid-Atlantic cross-dock search twice, and Moss added a report-label change to the handoff list. We can't see whether the label has been changed since.
- "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, a Gulf Coast drayage account. It turns up in both the retail notes and the port-logistics search results.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail (Covey / CLR / PHL)" and warns to check the org ID before bulk seat audits, because the two PHL accounts collide.
- To tell them apart: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Could you help get the saved report label and the PHL code cleaned up in the report and in the internal references?

Thanks,
Bettina
